About Me

Camera 1,
every ball

I'm a sports broadcast cameraman and I work the main camera: the high position straight behind the bowler's arm that the whole broadcast is built around. Every delivery, every stroke, every run goes out through this shot.

I've done it for the ICC at the Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2025 in Bangkok and for the Asian Cricket Council at the Men's Premier Cup 2026 in Malaysia. Back home I cover league, doctors', women's and wheelchair cricket across Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

I work with MSA Sports Video Production, a sports video production company delivering live streams and broadcast coverage for cricket tournaments in India and overseas.
